subject.title: feat(onboarding): prefer strongest local model in guided detection

question: Should OpenClaw adopt and publicly expose a global model-family heuristic as the default local onboarding selection policy?
rationale: The choice changes first-run provider/model behavior and creates a plugin SDK contract whose future retuning may affect external plugins; code correctness alone cannot establish the intended long-term product policy.

options.title: Use capability-based ranking
options.body: Revise the selection contract to incorporate capacity or provider metadata and candidate fallback before making it the shared default.

options.title: Approve the heuristic contract
options.body: Accept family-name ranking as a deliberately retunable public SDK policy and document its compatibility expectations and calibration source.

options.title: Keep existing selection
options.body: Retain provider discovery order until a stronger cross-provider ranking contract and live proof are available.

recommendation.title: Use capability-based ranking
recommendation.body: Revise the selection contract to incorporate capacity or provider metadata and candidate fallback before making it the shared default.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is most directly connected to the guided-onboarding direction and recent local-provider implementation history.
